items.title: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
items.summary: French authorities recorded 90 crypto-related cases involving kidnapping, extortion, threats and violent theft in seven months.

items.title: Bitcoin Bleeds in Uptober—How Low Can It Go? Experts Weigh In
items.summary: Experts highlight several support levels, from $83,000 down to $72,000, that Bitcoin may need to test in a bearish start to Uptober.

items.title: Base creator Jesse Pollak says equities and non-dollar stablecoins will lead upcoming ‘tokenization supercycle’
items.summary: Coinbase launched tokenized stocks on Base six weeks ago, with about $70 million to $100 million in daily volume, according to Pollak.

items.title: DWF Labs subsidiaries sue BitGo for $141 million over alleged token lock-up breach
items.summary: DWF is seeking $114 million in damages on the basis BitGo’s token sales resulted in direct losses through the fall in tokens' prices.
